'''Matcha Flavoured 1.01''', the "Desert Hotfix", is a hotfix for [[Matcha Flavoured 1.0|1.0]], published on July 26, 2026.<ref>{{Cite changelog|1.01}}</ref>

== Fixes ==
* Deserts generate as deserts again.
* Spruce and dark prismarine (now [[Malachite|dark malachite]]) stairs can be crafted in a crafting table.
* The <code>en_us</code> language file is copied to <code>en_ca</code>, <code>en_au</code> and <code>en_gb</code>, so the pack's names appear in those English variants.
